summary: Ally Financial Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of fixed-to-floating rate senior unsecured notes; the registrant is the issuer. Pricing terms (aggregate principal, initial coupon, SOFR spread, maturity, redemption schedule) are left blank in this preliminary filing, so no per-share or premium economics apply. Notes rank pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt, are structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities, and are not FDIC-insured. Joint book-running managers are BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan, TD Securities and Wells Fargo Securities. Watch final coupon, size and spread to benchmarks.
